precommitted_interpretation_checks: Displayed Q3-minus-Q2 USD-thousand deltas: operating revenues +20747, operating expenses -1709, operating income +22456. Revenue minus expenses reconciles operating income in each quarter. These are sequential, not year-over-year values.

Other expense, net rises +3788 USD thousand; operating income +22456 minus +3788 equals pre-tax income +18668. Taxes fall -3068; pre-tax +18668 minus taxes -3068 equals net income +21736. This is an accounting bridge, not evidence of why the business changed.

Diluted EPS rises 3.92 to 4.25 USD/share, +0.33; diluted weighted-average shares fall 77496 to 76579 thousand, -917 thousand. Rounding and weighted-share conventions matter; do not attribute all EPS growth to net income or buybacks without further evidence.
All money rows are USD thousands in the source. Reporting 793426 as USD millions would be a 1000-fold unit error.
Two adjacent quarters and a source-bounded income statement do not establish durability, valuation, or a trading conclusion.
